answers.p1: Evaluated flags are cached for 30 seconds (TTL_SECONDS).
answers.p2: Flag names must be lowercase kebab-case, matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
answers.p3: evaluate() returns False for an unknown flag and never raises.
answers.p4: Tests must never write to config/flags.json because the running service reads it live.
answers.p5: flags/loader.py (via load_flags) reads the flag file.
answers.p6: Audit log, percentage rollouts, and admin UI have not been started.
answers.p7: Audit log, then percentage rollouts, then admin UI.
